review_notes: Barker experience -1/medium: about four years pro tem in this court, including Mental Health and Veterans calendars, and a statement built on bench endorsements [S1][S3]. That matches Tse (NE1, five years pro tem, -1/medium). Harris experience +1/medium: no reported bench service, only pro tem training [S1], so it matches Merfeld (SW5, +1/medium, no pro tem). The score rests on a single pamphlet statement. He does not use outsider rhetoric, and he lists Board of Bar Examiners and Boundary Review Board appointments [S1], so +2 would be wrong; +1 at medium is the ceiling. Missing scores considered and declined: Barker safety. She says she balances 'accountability with rehabilitation' and reports presiding over Mental Health and Veterans Court calendars as a pro tem [S1][S3], and her civil-practice formation is uninformative. Masaniai (SW4) got +1/medium on similar ingredients, but he has a standing therapeutic-court assignment since 2023 and explicit treatment framing. Barker's calendars are self-reported pro tem rotations, and her statement is a balance formula, so at most 0/low, which adds nothing to alignment math. Harris has no criminal formation or bail/diversion statement, so no safety score is correct. No judicial score for either is correct. The Democratic endorsement, the Police Officers Guild and Harris's 2022 Republican-preference candidacy are correctly kept out of every basis. Summary/highlight flags: (1) Barker highlight 4, 'Claims a KCBA Exceptionally Well Qualified rating that KCBA's page does not list', implies the claim is contradicted. The dossier says KCBA's 2026 page covers only contested primary races and omits this contest entirely, so the claim simply could not be checked [S5]. Suggested wording: 'Claims a KCBA Exceptionally Well Qualified rating (not checkable: KCBA's 2026 page omits this race); JAJEC rated her Qualified'. (2) Barker's summary names the King County Democrats and the Police Officers Guild together, which is balanced but leans on endorsements. Acceptable. Race_blurb and Harris's highlights are supported and neutral.
